title: Move an owner forward
summary: The Owner pipeline: find the owner who waits longest, call with the script, nudge, open their steps.

steps.text: Every owner's car by step: the cards with the most days in a step come first. Red means stalled.
Read the card: the next action and whose turn it is.
Open Call script and call the owner; it fits the step they are on.
If they do not answer, press Nudge: a branded email and a text with their next step.
Open the owner to see each car's steps, the blockers and the one next action.
